description: This Java class defines a security filter for processing API key authentication requests in the Thingsboard server, extending Spring Security's AbstractAuthenticationProcessingFilter.

classes.name: ApiKeyTokenAuthenticationProcessingFilter
classes.description: A Spring Security filter that processes API key authentication by extracting tokens from request headers and managing security context upon success or failure.

methods.name: ApiKeyTokenAuthenticationProcessingFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with failure handler, token extractor, and request matcher.

methods.name: attemptAuthentication
methods.description: Extracts API key from request and attempts authentication.

methods.name: successfulAuthentication
methods.description: Sets the security context upon successful authentication and proceeds with filter chain.

methods.name: requiresAuthentication
methods.description: Determines if the request requires authentication based on headers.

methods.name: unsuccessfulAuthentication
methods.description: Clears security context and triggers failure handler on authentication failure.
